## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      6 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 4, 2026 - Aug 9, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Hallie1.0_, Aug 7, 2026, 1/5: "I used this app for 20 years and had a premium subscription. The new update is totally frustrating and unworkable. Not being able to see all of my logged food at the same time on one screen anymore was the last straw. I moved on and found something that works much better."
            2. _Pwecamp_, Aug 9, 2026, 2/5: "Lately MFP has been suggesting the same meal every day. I don’t want to eat the same thing for five days in a row. Needs to have more recipes. I canceled my subscription because of this limitation. C"
            3. _Keritano_, Aug 7, 2026, 2/5: ""Swipe right to log yesterday's meal" does not work anymore, goal setting page has nice updates but is not intuitive - specifically having to toggle recommend calories off. I don't like that I have to do 2 clicks to look at my nutrients. I consider this to be the main reason I use the app so having it be on the third tab over in progress and hidden until nutrients is clicked feels like a lot of friction for a UX perspective. Also just in general salty that you guys moved scan bar code to a premium feature when it used to be a free feature. Placing a free feature behind a paywall after roll out is a bad business model."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Ads pressure.**
      1 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Aug 8, 2026 - Aug 9, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Azreal743_, Aug 8, 2026, 1/5: "Got the email to renew premium, awesome good to go. They didn’t renew. Now the price online is more than the renewal email they sent me. No way to contact them as the only emails from them are from “no-reply” emails. This platform continues to lose value for the basic things. I don’t care about all this GLP-1 injection nonsense constantly advertised in the app. They had a solid way for me to track my data. I’ve been a premium subscriber for years. Now the updates degrade the user experience, the “ads” in the premium version were pushing GLP injections as “health”, and now they are misleading on renewals. I don’t even know how I could challenge that this could get less customer friendly."
            2. _TbirdieUK_, Aug 9, 2026, 2/5: "Used to be a great app. Now the free tier is unusable due to nonstop pop up ads. Paid is £65/year. Recommend MyNetDiary, free tier much better and paid is £25/year. Interface is at least as good and I think better."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 18, 2026 - Aug 9, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _anjamaresak_, Aug 8, 2026, 1/5: "I used & paid for this app for years. This upgrade made it completely unusable. It’s a shame all the new users have NO IDEA how great this used to be."
            2. _sooooooppphhhhiiiiaaaaa_, Aug 7, 2026, 1/5: "Im never one to leave a bad review. But the update sucks. I have used MFP for over a decade and this is what is finally gonna be pushing me to search for another app. The new update makes tracking 10x more complicated and slows it down. Why change something that wasn’t broken? Why not listen to thousand of dissatisfied longtime users? Please give us an option to revert back."
            3. _theplasticdr_, Aug 3, 2026, 1/5: "New update is absolutely stupid and completely broken the app. So many things ruined, will cancel my membership and leave now. Do not update the app, MFP roll back this stupid update or allow people to use the old layout."
<!--/ir-theme-->
